# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About CourtnieCaseReady
CourtnieCaseReady is a premium legal evidence organizer with a luxury dark futuristic aesthetic featuring glowing electric blue accents and sophisticated data visualization. The platform embodies a high-tech, professional atmosphere with pulsing timeline nodes, glowing stat cards, and a sleek dark interface that conveys security and confidentiality. The design language emphasizes precision, organization, and cutting-edge legal technology with color-coded importance levels and intuitive navigation.

## Target Audience
legal professionals, attorneys, court case managers

## Industry
legal technology
